title: Proof of existence of the categorical Lagrangian
html:
Proof. Proof of existence of the categorical Lagrangian

The strategy is constructive. We define the specific endomorphism L_q = D^2 + \psi^* \otimes D \psi in \mathrm{End}(A) and verify that it correctly encapsulates both the kinetic and interaction terms, satisfying the requirements for the categorical Lagrangian.

\mathcal{D}_\nabla exists by (existence of Dirac operator), and \mathcal{D}_\nabla^2 \in \mathrm{End}_{\mathbf{C}}(A) is composition. \psi^* = \int_A \circ S(\psi) \colon A \to \mathbf{1} exists by the Frobenius form and antipode. The tensor \psi^* \otimes \mathcal{D}_\nabla \psi lies in \mathrm{Hom}(A, \mathbf{1}) \otimes \mathrm{Hom}(\mathbf{1}, \Omega^1(A)) \subseteq \mathrm{End}(A) via the rigid pairing. Addition of morphisms exists in any R-linear category; hence the sum \mathcal{L}_q \in \mathrm{End}(A).
